observations: Photo 0: A closed ASUS laptop on top of a stack of black laptop bases. The lid is silver-gray with the ASUS logo centered. The stack appears to be multiple identical units, suggesting bulk or resale.

Photo 1: The same laptop open, showing a black keyboard, trackpad, and a dark screen with visible smudges and reflections. The screen bezel has the ASUS logo. A second laptop is visible in the background, standing vertically with its screen facing forward, showing a reflection of the keyboard.

Photo 2: Similar to photo 1, but the background laptop is now angled to show its screen and hinge, confirming it is also an ASUS laptop. The screen is off, reflecting the keyboard and surroundings. The main laptop's screen still shows smudges and reflections.
All photos show a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'NICK MARK ENTERPRISE'.
No visible model number, serial number, or internal specs in any photo.
The laptops appear to be 2-in-1 convertible models due to the visible hinges and the way the background laptop is positioned.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be the claimed model (Asus Tp412) or may have different internal specs than advertised.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop or a screenshot of the system information (e.g., BIOS, Windows About page) showing the exact model and specs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 2-in-1 ASUS laptop without confirmed model or specs, which is lower than a confirmed Tp412 with i5-8th gen, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD.

risks.risk: The screen may have damage or dead pixels not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video or photo of the screen displaying a solid white or black color, or a full-screen test pattern, to check for dead pixels or screen defects.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential screen defects, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be functional or may have battery or hardware issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop powering on, booting to the desktop, and running a simple task (e.g., opening a browser or file explorer).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which is the worst-case scenario.

risks.risk: The stack of laptops may be used for bulk resale, and the top unit may not be representative of the others (e.g., different condition, model, or specs).
risks.proof: A photo of the bottom of the top laptop showing the model label, and a photo of the bottom of one of the stacked units to confirm they are identical.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single unit with unknown condition of the stack, which reduces value.
